description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the combined training set, with each segment representing a different source and its corresponding proportion. The largest segment, labeled NQ, accounts for 31.3% of the data and is colored blue. The second largest is FEVER at 16.1%, shown in a teal color. VITAMINC contributes 13.0% and is depicted in light blue. SNLI makes up 15.4% and is colored orange. MULTIFC and MULTINLI each contribute 0.5% and are represented by very small green and light blue segments, respectively. SCITAIL accounts for 1.2% and is shown in a light green color. The remaining sources are FACTCC (2.6%, yellow), ANLI (4.6%, orange), ENFIA (1.8%, green), and SCIFACT (0.1%, dark green), with the latter being the smallest segment. The chart uses labels and lines to connect each segment to its corresponding source and percentage value, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right.
